_about: The message copy files, in the order they are written to out/template-copy.md by the checklist command.

In the copy: ${...} is filled from client.yaml (as everywhere in this repo); {{...}} is a GHL merge field and is left alone; [[WRITE: ...]] is a line the copywriter writes for this client (business-specific: a story, a product list).
Everything here is DRAFT. The client approves it in writing before any workflow that sends is switched on.
